metrics.definition: Wall clock from accepted episode truth to independently verified outcome; include waiting, repairs and all retries. Derive from acceptedTruthAt/verifiedOutcomeAt; unresolved outcome remains null, never zero.
Observed contract violations after an engineering success/release claim during the fixed follow-up, including false Saved/Locked. Count each distinct incident once; preserve recurrence evidence.
Additional repair episodes for the same approved obligation after the first claimed completion; exclude new approved requirements.
Observed unapproved behavioral differences affecting protected obligations; ordinary authorized amendments are separately recorded and cannot be matched across editions.
All active engineering/operator diagnosis minutes, summed across people; exclude waiting, track full episode.
All active implementation and repair minutes, summed across people; do not omit repeat repairs.
All active specification, contract review and maintenance minutes, including Human review where applicable.
All active verification operation/maintenance minutes across people; CI elapsed waiting is included in outcome wall time, not double counted as active work.
Actual monetary contract/specification maintenance cost in CAD; record known zero only if observed, otherwise null. No guessed model costs.
Actual monetary verification cost including paid execution and compute in CAD; no spend authorized by this protocol, record unknown when unavailable.
Times Human repeats an already accepted promise because the system lost/misunderstood it; Human adjudicates distinction from legitimate successor meaning.
Human-requested/operated reproduction attempts including failed attempts; count all registered attempts.
Total active Human time across narration, restatement, reproduction, review and unnecessary technical choices. Overlap with engineering cost categories is reported, not summed twice.
Technical choices returned to Human despite existing authority/approved meaning; Human adjudicates necessary meaning/authority decisions separately.

baselineRule: Prospective current supported build reference, not an invented before-CI history. Freeze actual baseline and candidate revisions in a reviewed successor protocol before collecting four matched repair/workflow episodes per cohort. Current candidate revision is unknown; no comparison is authorized.
collectionRule: Human reviews full protocol digest and thresholds under #2943 before any cohort episode starts; host approval reference/timestamp/digest is separate from dataset. Use same approved Save edition, device/runtime/provider configuration, pseudonymous equivalent disposable workload, permissions, initial state, fault schedule and scope per pair. Register all four case episodes per cohort in Casebook before starting; retain every attempt, blocked/unknown outcome and zero/missing distinction. Episode follows an equivalent accepted repair request through independently verified outcome and fixed follow-up to next normal restart/Library reopening; record known intervening failures/repairs and all active effort. No forced execution on real private work or paid inference.
comparisonLimits: Four matched episodes per cohort is a proposed small exploratory campaign, not statistical power or proof of causation. Non-increase for every metric plus zero candidate escaped failures/unexpected changes and strict practical reliability/Human-burden improvement; unknown/blocked/incomparable episodes make comparison UNPROVEN. Freeze amended protocol and start a new campaign if conditions or criteria change. This prospective reference cannot establish how the full historical CI transition changed outcomes.
